missions.name: Dead Stock Analysis
missions.query: What SKUs have not had any sales events in the last 6 months and have a stock count greater than 50?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Detection
missions.query: Which products have a size distribution that significantly deviates from the average size distribution across all products in the same category?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Risk Assessment
missions.query: Which suppliers have a lead time greater than 30 days and an on-time rate less than 90%, and what is the total value of inventory from these suppliers?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Analysis
missions.query: Which SKUs have a stock count below their reorder point and have not been restocked in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Overstock Risk Detection
missions.query: Which products have a stock count greater than 200 and a sales rate per day that is less than 1 unit, indicating potential overstocking?

missions.name: Channel Sales Discrepancy
missions.query: Are there any discrepancies in sales events between different channels (e.g., online vs. in-store) that could indicate inventory management issues or channel-specific trends?

missions.name: Product Category Profitability
missions.query: Which product categories have the highest and lowest profitability based on unit cost, retail price, and sales volume, and what are the implications for inventory management and pricing strategies?

missions.name: Supplier Country Risk Assessment
missions.query: Are there any suppliers from countries with high geopolitical risk or trade restrictions, and what is the potential impact on inventory availability and lead times?
